clips.title: The story
paras: Across Dun Morogh’s frigid peaks, the Frostmane tribe fights to reclaim its home. These ice trolls are native to the mountains, but dwarves drove them into caves and remote ridges centuries ago. From there, the Frostmane wage a guerrilla war against the dwarves.

Long before the Bronzebeard clan united under Ironforge, the Frostmane trolls ruled across Dun Morogh’s snowbound reaches. The rise and spread of the dwarven kingdom crushed their realm, forcing survivors to retreat into caves and along frozen ridges and crags. That defeat bred a bitter hatred passed down through generations. To the Frostmane, every mountaineer, traveler, and homestead is an invader to drive out or slaughter.

For decades, the Ironforge Senate saw the Frostmane as little more than a nuisance in the hills. Then the trogg menace emerged deep beneath Dun Morogh, throwing dwarven defenses into disarray. With the mountaineers overwhelmed and dwarven forces fighting Alliance wars abroad, the Frostmane seized their chance. From strongholds such as Frostmane Hold and Shimmer Ridge, they launched renewed, violent raids to reclaim their ancient lands.
